meta.name: Alien: Earth
meta.description: Cuando una misteriosa nave espacial se estrella en la Tierra, una joven y un grupo heterogéneo de soldados tácticos hacen un descubrimiento fatídico que los pone cara a cara con la mayor amenaza del planeta.

videos.title: El País de Nunca Jamás
videos.overview: Tras estrellarse una nave espacial en la Tierra, una mujer busca a su hermano.

videos.title: Mr. October
videos.overview: Crece la tensión entre empresas rivales, hay un reencuentro inesperado y un secreto sale a la luz.

videos.title: Metamorfosis
videos.overview: El equipo regresa con una carga inesperada y un experimento inquietante se lleva a cabo.

videos.title: Observación
videos.overview: Cuando una conspiración encubierta amenaza a todos, se genera un vínculo inesperado.

videos.title: En el espacio, nadie...
videos.overview: Una nave en peligro en el espacio exterior lleva a un peligroso ajuste de cuentas.

videos.title: El vuelo
videos.overview: Se enfrentan poderosos enemigos, aumenta la tensión, y la curiosidad lleva a consecuencias mortales.

videos.title: Emergencia
videos.overview: Un plan de escape desata divisiones, traiciones y un impactante enfrentamiento.

videos.title: Los verdaderos monstruos
videos.overview: Surge una nueva dinámica de poder

videos.title: Alien: Earth Podcast Episode 1: Neverland
videos.overview: When a spaceship crash-lands on Earth, a sister searches for her brother amidst an unexpected alien threat.  Host Adam Rogers breaks down episode 1 of FX’s Alien: Earth with series creator Noah Hawley, co-EP Migizi Pensoneau, and actor Sydney Chandler.  Join them as they discuss everything from immortality and trillionaires to Peter Pan and facehuggers in the dramatic opening to this new chapter of the Alien universe.

videos.title: Alien: Earth Podcast Episode 2: Mr. October
videos.overview: Tensions rise between rival corporations, a reunion takes place, and a secret is revealed. Host Adam Rogers break down episode 2 of FX’s Alien: Earth with EP Dana Gonzalez, actor Essie Davis, stuntman Cameron Booth, and Co-EP Migizi Pensoneau. Join Adam in discovering what it takes to bring the Xenomorph to life on set, how to bring a franchise all about space down to Earth, and what separates a human from a hybrid.

videos.title: Alien: Earth Podcast Episode 3: Metamorphosis
videos.overview: The team returns home with unexpected cargo. An unsettling experiment occurs, and a new talent is discovered.  Adam Rogers breaks down episode 3 of FX’s Alien: Earth with series creator Noah Hawley, Co-EP Migizi Pensoneau, costume designer Suttirat Larlab, and actor Samuel Blenkin.  Join them as they discuss the Xenomorph at the peak of its evolution, Boy K’s bare feet, and what makes a machine a machine.

videos.title: Alien: Earth Podcast Episode 4: Observation
videos.overview: An unexpected connection is formed while a covert plot puts everyone in danger. Host Adam Rogers breaks down episode 4 of FX’s Alien: Earth with director Ugla Hauksdóttir, visual effects supervisor Jonathan Rothbart, and actors Lily Newmark, Adarsh Gourav, and Sydney Chandler. Join them to dive deep into the elements of horror and love present in this episode, the making of a more disgusting monster, and the motivations behind two Lost Boys who are more lost than ever before.

videos.title: Alien: Earth Podcast Episode 5: In Space, No One...
videos.overview: An outer-space vessel in peril leads to a dangerous reckoning. Host Adam Rogers breaks down episode 5 of FX’s Alien: Earth with series creator Noah Hawley, editor Regis Kimble, and actors Babou Ceesay and Richa Moorjani. Join Adam back where the Alien franchise started, in space, to pull back the curtain on Noah Hawley's original TV series version of an Alien movie.

videos.title: On-Set Dispatches 1: First Look
videos.overview: Fear takes new forms. Go behind the scenes on the set of FX’s Alien: Earth and see what’s in store for humanity when technology and biology collide—with deadly consequences.

videos.title: On-Set Dispatches 2: Creating the Crash Sequence
videos.overview: Creator Noah Hawley joins the cast and crew to break down the colossal sets, stunts, and effects that went into the explosive first episode of FX’s Alien: Earth.

videos.title: On-Set Dispatches 3: Fabricating the Future with Costumes, Hair and Make-Up
videos.overview: “It’s almost like doing a PhD in the world of Alien.” Sit down with Suttirat Anne Larlarb (Costume Designer), Sanna Seppanen (Hair Head of Department), and Connie Lynn Parker (Make-Up Head of Department) for a deep dive into the visual aesthetic of Alien: Earth’s retro-futurist world.

videos.title: On-Set Dispatches 4: Inside Episode Five's Tribute to the Legacy
videos.overview: Step on the set of the USCSS Maginot to see the making of Episode Five’s action-packed homage to the franchise, joined by cast and crew sharing their reflections on the original film.

videos.title: Alien: Earth Podcast Episode 6: The Fly
videos.overview: Tensions rise as powerful enemies confront each other, a dangerous plan unfolds, and curiosity leads to deadly consequences. Host Adam Rogers breaks down episode 6 of FX’s Alien: Earth with Ugla Hauskdóttir, production designer Andy Nicholson, actors David Rhysdal and Essie Davis, and Co-EP Migizi Pensoneau. Join them as they discuss the false promise of immortality, adapting the Alien aesthetic to Earth, and trying to do what's right in a world of shifting morality.

videos.title: Alien: Earth Podcast Episode 7: Emergence
videos.overview: An escape plan is hatched leading to a breaking of factions, betrayals, and a shocking confrontation.  Host Adam Rogers breaks down episode 7 of FX’s Alien: Earth with series creator Noah Hawley, director Dana Gonzales, composer Jeff Russo, and music supervisor Maggie Phillips. Join Adam for the penultimate episode of the show to dive into the creation of the score, look back at how far our characters have come from episode 1, and wonder at the costs of scientific advancement.

videos.title: Alien: Earth Podcast Episode 8: The Real Monsters
videos.overview: A new power dynamic emerges.  Host Adam Rogers break down episode 8 of FX’s Alien: Earth with series creator Noah Hawley, Co-EP Migizi Pensoneau, actress Sydney Chandler, and stunt coordinator Rob Inch.  Join them to discuss crafting a finale, choreographing the high impact fight scenes, and befriending the perfect organism.

videos.title: On-Set Dispatches 5: Tour the Sets with Production Designer Andy Nicholson
videos.overview: There’s terror around every corner. Step onto the soundstages for a guided tour of the meticulously detailed spaceships, laboratories, and research facilities that make up the world of Alien: Earth.

videos.title: On-Set Dispatches 6: Up Close with the New Creatures
videos.overview: “When you’re filming down dark hallways and there’s a monster behind you, there’s really a monster behind you.” Meet the puppeteers, sculptors, and artists who breathed life into the menagerie of extraterrestrial creatures that populate Alien: Earth.

videos.title: Cast Q&A with Sydney Chandler and Alex Lawther
videos.overview: Alex (Hermit) and Sydney (Wendy) have very different ideas on who's most likely to survive...

videos.title: Cast Q&A with Adarsh Gourav and Jonathan Ajayi
videos.overview: Who’d you want to be stuck with on a ship for decades? Easy: Adarsh and Jonathan.

videos.title: Cast Q&A with Babou Ceesay and Samuel Blenkin
videos.overview: Babou Ceesay and Samuel Blenkin reveal what drew them to working on Alien: Earth, their favorite on-set moments, and Samuel’s sinister side.

videos.title: Cast Q&A with David Rysdahl and Essie Davis
videos.overview: David Rysdahl and Essie Davis share survival odds, favorite downtime hobbies, and which creatures they’d take on.

videos.title: Cast Q&A with Erana James and Lily Newmark
videos.overview: Erana James and Lily Newmark share their thoughts on alien attacks, on-set activities, and the ideal hypersleep playlist.

videos.title: On-Set Dispatches 7: Stunt Coordinator Rob Inch Breaks Down the Action
videos.overview: See what it took behind the scenes to pull off the massive practical stunts on Alien: Earth, from combat training to wire work and fight choreography.

videos.title: The Alien: Earth Cast Plays “Who’s Most Likely?”
videos.overview: Who’s most likely to survive an alien attack? The cast of Alien: Earth reveals all.

videos.title: On-Set Dispatches 8: How the Series Filmed on Location in Thailand
videos.overview: Lush jungles. Bustling canals. Tag along with the production team of Alien: Earth as they scout locations across the country, while the cast reflects on the collaboration between local Thai artists and crew members from around the world.

videos.title: On-Set Dispatches 9: Becoming the Xenomorph with Actor Cameron Brown
videos.overview: Meet the man behind the mask as actor Cameron Brown reveals what it takes to step into the shoes of the most iconic character in the franchise.
